value.rationale: Zero gross work at an observation horizon is a natural failure-risk observable despite positive average work, and parity makes ordinary smooth-density large deviations quantitatively incorrect. The exact exponential rate and initial-state prefactor give a usable probability scale; the q→1 crossover precisely identifies the feedback-reduction window n(1-q)^2≈1 where work cancellation ceases to be exponentially unlikely. The unique symmetric driven transition kernel clarifies the rare mechanism and is not a trivial restatement of the mean work or original first-passage statistics.
